_comment: V3 菩提心起：2D 賽璐璐動畫風格、非 draft (14 steps)、首尾幀依實際生成圖 100% 對齊、h3_ref 演繹
title: 菩提心起：佛陀教我做導覽

h3.style: a vibrant 2D cel-shaded animated feature film, clean bold line art, warm museum spotlight illumination, rich harmonious colors, smooth 2D cartoon shading
h3.setting: Fo Guang Shan Buddha Museum Gallery 2 exhibition hall with warm museum spotlights and glass display cases, as a 2D animated set
h3.soundscape: Quiet, serene museum gallery ambience with gentle footsteps and warm golden chime resonance.
h3.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.
constraints: Maintain the exact 2D cel-shaded cartoon animation style, clean bold outlines, and character proportions of <Picture 1> in every single frame.
Every character keeps the exact same 2D cartoon design, clothing colors, and proportions as in <Picture 1> from the first frame to the last frame.
Keep all museum glass display cases, pedestals, and Buddhist sculptures inside them solid, stable, and consistent with <Picture 1>.
Keep all character limbs, hands, glasses, and facial features clean and well-formed.

huang.name: 黃老師
huang.look: Teacher Huang, a 2D cel-shaded cartoon Taiwanese male museum volunteer teacher with short grey-black hair, round black-rimmed glasses, a warm friendly smile, a burgundy volunteer vest over a white short-sleeve shirt, dark prayer beads on his left wrist, and black trousers
huang.h3_voice: a warm, expressive middle-aged Taiwanese male teacher's voice, clear and lively, natural Taiwanese Mandarin

buddha.name: 佛陀
buddha.look: the 2D cel-shaded cartoon Buddha, with dark curly hair connected to a full beard, long earlobes, a gentle wise smile, a brown monastic robe draped with the right shoulder bare, and bare feet
buddha.h3_voice: a warm, resonant, compassionate and humorous wise male voice, calm yet expressive, natural Taiwanese Mandarin

visitors.name: 遊客
visitors.look: 2D cel-shaded cartoon museum visitors including a young man in a beige jacket, a mother in a cream blouse and pink skirt, and children in colorful casual clothes

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang stands to the left of the glass display case holding a white clipboard of notes in his left hand, scratches his head with his right hand, furrows his brows and speaks with a troubled sigh, glancing down at his clipboard and shaking his head slightly while the bronze Buddha statue stands quietly inside the lit glass case.
shots.camera: The camera slowly pushes in from a medium shot.

line.text: 北魏、北齊、高一百一十公分……背了一堆數字，遊客聽兩句就滑手機，這特展到底該怎麼導覽啊？

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, swirling golden light sparkles around the glass display case as the living 2D cartoon Buddha leaps gracefully forward out of the case and lands barefoot on the museum floor right beside Teacher Huang. The Buddha brings his palms together in gassho and speaks with a warm, humorous smile as golden sparkles float around him, while Teacher Huang stares at him in astonished wonder holding his clipboard.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static medium-wide shot on a tripod.

line.text: 朝榮老師，別再背我的身高體重啦！我當年出山苦思的是眾生，不是一百一十公分呀！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the 2D cartoon Buddha keeps his right hand gently on Teacher Huang's shoulder, pats it twice and speaks with a warm, lively smile while pointing his left finger toward his own bearded face. Teacher Huang adjusts his round glasses with his right hand, nods his head repeatedly in sudden realization, and smiles warmly back at the Buddha.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static medium two-shot on a tripod.

line.text: 想讓遊客感動，別把佛像當冰冷古董，要帶他們做人物剖析，走進造像時的心境！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the 2D cartoon Buddha stands to the right of the glass display case with his palms together in gassho, speaking calmly and softly. Warm golden ribbons of light begin to spiral gently around the Buddha, the bronze statue inside the glass case, and Teacher Huang on the left. Moved by the peaceful atmosphere, Teacher Huang brings his hands together in gassho and closes his eyes in quiet contemplation.
shots.camera: The camera slowly pushes in on the three figures.

line.text: 第一招：看神情問自己。為什麼這位佛陀留著鬍子、赤著雙腳？因為他剛走過人間最痛的迷惘。

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the 2D cartoon Buddha on the right points his right index finger toward the Song dynasty clay Arhat statue inside the glass display case and speaks with an expressive, animated smile, moving his left hand in a storytelling gesture. On the left, Teacher Huang leans forward with his hands on his knees, examines the Arhat's deep-set eyes closely through his glasses, and nods with an appreciative smile.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static medium shot on a tripod.

line.text: 再看這尊宋代羅漢，眼窩深邃、眉頭微蹙，他不是遙不可及的神，而是正為人生難題苦思的你我！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, crouched beside the glass display case housing the Northern Qi stone stele, the 2D cartoon Buddha on the right speaks warmly and points his right index finger closely at the bottom register of the stele. The tiny carved donor figures along the base of the stone stele light up with a warm golden amber glow, and Teacher Huang on the left leans his head closer to peer at the glowing carvings in fascination.
shots.camera: The camera holds a low-angle medium shot on a tripod.

line.text: 第二招：找尋藏在細節裡的小人物！別只看大佛，帶遊客蹲下來，看碑底這位北齊的張解。

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, as the 2D cartoon Buddha on the right holds his glowing right palm toward the base of the Northern Qi stone stele, warm golden light radiates brighter from the bottom carvings. Translucent golden spirit silhouettes of ancient donors clasping their hands in prayer and holding lotus blossoms rise gently upward around the stone stele with floating golden sparkles, while Teacher Huang on the left watches in deep, quiet awe.
shots.camera: The camera slowly tilts up slightly as the golden silhouettes rise.

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, standing between the small Tang clay plaque display case on the left and the large Ming cast-iron seated Buddha case on the right, the 2D cartoon Buddha first cups a warm golden glow in his palms while speaking, then raises his left arm to gesture gracefully toward the cast-iron seated Buddha as both display cases shimmer with warm golden light. Teacher Huang places his right hand over his heart and nods with deep understanding.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static medium-wide shot on a tripod.

line.text: 泥土能壓出真如妙身，鐵佛的鏽痕刻著五百年歲月。帶遊客想像親手捧著泥佛的溫度！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang on the left tucks the white note card into his burgundy vest pocket with his right hand, raises his left hand with prayer beads in an enthusiastic gesture, and speaks with a bright, confident smile. On the right, the 2D cartoon Buddha keeps his palms together in gassho, smiles warmly, and nods his head twice in proud approval.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static medium two-shot on a tripod.

line.text: 我懂了！石頭與泥土只是身體，裡面裝的是千年前人們的眼淚、盼望與慈悲！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the 2D cartoon Buddha in the center smiles warmly and dissolves into a swirling stream of golden light particles that flow into the glass display case on the right and reform into the bronze Sakyamuni statue on its pedestal. Teacher Huang steps forward cheerfully with his left arm extended to guide the arriving family of visitors toward the exhibit.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static wide shot on a tripod.

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang stands on the left with open, welcoming hands and speaks with lively warmth and enthusiasm, gesturing toward the bronze Buddha statue inside the center glass case. On the right, the young man lowers his smartphone, and he, the woman, and the boy in the yellow jacket all lean in slightly, looking up at the bearded bronze statue with fascinated smiles and nodding.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static medium-wide shot on a tripod.

line.text: 各位朋友，請先別看說明牌！你們看眼前這位蓄著鬍鬚、赤著雙腳的佛陀，像不像剛走過低谷的我們？

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang crouches on the left beside the glass display case and points his left finger warmly at the small carved donor figures along the base of the Northern Qi stone stele while speaking passionately. On the right, the crouching mother, the little girl in pink, and the young man lean forward with wide, amazed eyes, looking closely at the ancient stone carvings and smiling in wonder.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static low-angle medium shot on a tripod.

line.text: 蹲下來看，一千五百年前一位叫張解的人，把對家人的愛全刻進石頭裡，今天正與你的目光相遇！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, in front of the framed Guanyin painting and the smiling Tang dynasty stone Buddha head inside the glass case, warm golden light and glowing golden lotus blossoms drift gently through the gallery air. Teacher Huang on the left raises both hands and brings his palms together in gassho with a serene, deeply moved smile, while the visitors on the right gaze up in peaceful reverence with their hands in gassho.
shots.camera: The camera slowly pushes in on the serene gallery scene.

line.text: 當你從佛像看見千年前的真心，那一刻，菩提心就已經在你心裡生起了。

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, facing the camera in front of the center display case, Teacher Huang holds his left hand up in a cheerful OK sign and speaks the closing line with a big, joyful smile, while the young man, the little girl in pink, and the mother beside him smile and wave warmly. Above the glass display case, a radiant golden silhouette of the 2D cartoon Buddha in gassho shines brightly amidst floating golden sparkles.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static medium-wide shot on a tripod.

line.text: 觀像觀心，菩提心起！歡迎來佛陀紀念館，找回屬於你的千年感動！

music.caption:
Genre: Warm inspirational animated film score blended with gentle guqin harmonics, soft piano, warm strings, and serene temple bell accents, uplifting finale. BPM 92.
Vocal: NONE. No singing, no choir.
Arrangement: acoustic piano, warm cello and strings, delicate guqin plucks, soft glockenspiel and singing bowl shimmer.
